title: LongMemEval cleaned full-set flat-BM25 source-aligned reproduction

deviations: The official runner imports CUDA, Torch, sentence-transformers, Transformers, and OpenAI modules even for flat-BM25. The reproduction therefore uses a lightweight runner that copies the pinned session corpus construction, rank_bm25 tokenization and ranking, target derivation, exclusions, k values, and metric formulae.

dataset.name: LongMemEval-S cleaned
dataset.split: all 500 released questions; official retrieval exclusions applied

controls.tokenization: Python str.split(' ') on each user-only session and question

sample.eligible_questions: determined only by the official exclusion rules

results.stopping_rule: complete all eligible released questions or fail without changing algorithm, data, or exclusions
results.promotion_rule: report as source-aligned reproduction only; never as official leaderboard or end-to-end QA performance
results.no_target_note: All 51 no-target exclusions are single-session-assistant questions under the official user-only retrieval target rule.

cost.note: Local deterministic lexical retrieval; no hosted-model calls.

result_addendum: A first detached execution and the final artifact execution produced the same retrieval_rows SHA-256.
The source-aligned runner's three unit tests passed in the pinned temporary environment.

The official all-dependency runner was not executed because it imports dense/CUDA dependencies for the lexical arm; this limits the claim to source alignment rather than byte-identical harness execution.
claim_boundary: Full-set source-aligned reproduction of the official LongMemEval flat-BM25 session retrieval definition. The primary result is recall_all@5 = 311/419 eligible questions. This is not an official leaderboard submission, not end-to-end QA, and not a MindMap result.
